rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KORnieoch
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. Strong fragrance. Full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Heat tolerant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: The blooms are an interesting color combination -- pink in the center, shading to greenish-white on the outer petals.
